lede: The big question this week is gondola funding — the Gondola Subcommittee meets Monday to hash out how to secure $18 million for federal grant requirements by fall, with local partners needing to formalize commitments soon. Meanwhile, Mountain Village votes Tuesday on fast-tracking affordable housing projects for state Prop 123 funding, and county commissioners interview candidates for planning boards.
